Rabies.name: Rabies
Rabies.desc:
Your basic attack is a melee attack. You can't equip face armor.
After each battle, gain +2 STR and -1 INT.
If your INT is 0 or less, you have Madness.

Boils.name: Boils
Boils.desc:
+1 Brace.
You spawn a puddle of creep whenever you get hit. You can't equip face armor.

Depression.name: Depression
Depression.desc: Adjacent units get All Stats Down 2.

BrokenLimb.name: Broken Limb
BrokenLimb.desc: You can't equip trinkets or consumables. +2 Thorns.

WrenchedNeck.name: Wrenched Neck
WrenchedNeck.desc: You can't equip neck armor. Double the effects of your head armor.

HeadTrauma.name: Head Trauma
HeadTrauma.desc: You can't equip head armor. Your Collarless spells cost -2 mana.

DeepCut.name: Deep Cut
DeepCut.desc:
Bleed 1.
You can't equip trinkets or consumables. 
Bonus ability: Bloodzerk.

PuncturedEye.name: Punctured Eye
PuncturedEye.desc:
+10% miss chance.
You can't equip face armor. Gain an eyeball trinket.

OCD.name: Obsessive Compulsive Disorder
OCD.desc:
Bonus Ability: Groom
At the end of your turn, if you didn't use Groom, take 2 damage.

Distemper.name: Distemper
Distemper.desc:
At the end of each battle gain +10% crit chance, +25% crit damage, and +5% miss chance. Permanently.
You can't equip face armor.

BrainDamage.name: Brain Damage
BrainDamage.desc: You can't use item actions. +2 Brace.

SeveredThumb.name: Severed Thumb
SeveredThumb.desc: You can't equip weapons. Spawn a Food pickup at the start of each battle.

PTSD.name: Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder
PTSD.desc: When you take damage, gain Fear and +2 Damage.

Dyskinesia.name: Dyskinesia
Dyskinesia.desc: When you end your movement, knockback all adjacent units 1 tile.

Anemia.name: Anemia
Anemia.desc:
When you take damage, you have a 10% chance to gain Bleed 1.
Gain 2 Charge for each damage you take from Bleed.

Empath.name: Empath
Empath.desc:
Take 1 damage when you deal damage.
Your heals heal for 1 extra.

Infestation.name: Infestation
Infestation.desc: At the start of your turn, you have a 50% chance to spawn a Maggot Familiar and 15% chance to spawn an enemy Flea.

Leprosy.name: Leprosy
Leprosy.desc: Bruise 2. When you get hit, spawn a food pickup.

ASRFight.name: Acute Stress Reaction: Fight
ASRFight.desc: Gain +6 STR while you have 5 or fewer HP.

ASRFlight.name: Acute Stress Reaction: Flight
ASRFlight.desc: Gain +6 SPD while you have 5 or fewer HP.

BloodFrenzy.name: Blood Frenzy
BloodFrenzy.desc: When you kill a unit, take an extra turn with Madness.

Shunned.name: Shunned
Shunned.desc:
Take your turn last.
Your heals heal for 2 less. +15% dodge chance.

Dysentery.name: Dysentery
Dysentery.desc: 50% chance to make a burning poop directly behind you when you end your turn.

Anxiety.name: Anxiety
Anxiety.desc: +10% Dodge chance. When you take damage, run away from the source.

Kamikazee.name: Kamikaze
Kamikazee.desc: You explode when you are downed.

Traumatophobia.name: Traumatophobia
Traumatophobia.desc: Whenever you take damage, move 1 tile away from the source.

StockholmSyndrome.name: Stockholm Syndrome
StockholmSyndrome.desc: Whenever you take damage, move toward the source.

ViolentOutbursts.name: Violent Outbursts
ViolentOutbursts.desc: When you end your turn, dash forward 2 tiles, attack with Knockback, and take 1 damage.

Scleroderma.name: Scleroderma
Scleroderma.desc: At the start of each battle, you lose all but 1 HP, but gain that much Shield.

Pacifist.name: Pacifist
Pacifist.desc: You can't kill units. If you end your turn without using your basic attack gain 7 mana.

FrozenKnee.name: The Zoomies
FrozenKnee.desc: Your movement action is a dash attack.

SchrodingerDisorder.name: Schrödinger's Syndrome
SchrodingerDisorder.desc: 50% chance to start each battle dead, or alive with max hp and All Stats Up 2 and an extra turn at the start of the battle.

FattyLiver.name: Fatty Liver
FattyLiver.desc: Whenever you lose HP, you permanently lose 1 CON.

CommonCold.name: The Common Cold
CommonCold.desc: Start each battle with All Stats Down. 30% chance of recovering at the end of each round. Contagious.

Pox.name: Pox
Pox.desc: 10% chance to skip your turn to scratch yourself. Your basic attack has a 50% chance to inflict Poison 1. 5% chance of recovering at the end of each round. Contagious.

Psychosis.name: Psychosis
Psychosis.desc: After your first turn, you have permanent madness.

Necrosis.name: Necrosis
Necrosis.desc: When you take damage, you get -1 CON, -1 STR, and spawn poisoned food.

Touched.name: Touched
Touched.desc: You can no longer heal HP.

Invincible.name: Immortal
Invincible.desc:
All damage you take is reduced to 1.
When you take damage, suffer a random injury.

ExplosiveGas.name: Bad Gas
ExplosiveGas.desc: On the first round, take your turn last. At the start of that turn, do a Mega Fart attack that inflicts Poison 2.

Toxoplasmosis.name: Toxoplasmosis
Toxoplasmosis.desc: Start each battle with a Rat Familiar. Your basic attack charms Rat enemies.

Ebola.name: Ebola
Ebola.desc:
Start each battle with Bleed 3. Your basic attack inflicts Bleed 2.
5% chance of recovering at the end of each round. Contagious.

Fidgety.name: Fidgety
Fidgety.desc: When you end your turn, automatically use your weapon on a random unit in range, for free.

Narcolepsy.name: Narcolepsy
Narcolepsy.desc: At the end of your turn, fall asleep, heal 10 HP and gain 7 mana.

Paranoia.name: Paranoia
Paranoia.desc: When a unit ends its movement directly behind you, attack it and gain Fear.

EatingDisorder.name: Eating Disorder
EatingDisorder.desc: Double the effects of your consumables but you are confused on how to eat them.

Gastritis.name: Gastritis
Gastritis.desc: At the end of your turn, fart and Poison all adjacent units.

Hypomania.name: Hypomania
Hypomania.desc: Start each battle with 3 bonus turns, then never take a turn.

Hypersomnia.name: Hypersomnia
Hypersomnia.desc: Start each battle asleep and with full health.

KidneyStones.name: Kidney Stone
KidneyStones.desc: When you end your turn take 1 damage and pass a kidney stone.

Cancer.name: Cancer
Cancer.desc: At the end of each battle, lose 3 random stats permanently and gain a random mutation.

Stinky.name: Stinky
Stinky.desc: Adjacent units move away from you at the start of their turns.

Incontinence.name: Incontinence
Incontinence.desc: When you take damage, pee yourself.

Fossilized.name: Fossilized
Fossilized.desc: +2 Brace. Slide like a rock whenever you get hit.

Triskaidekaphobia.name: Triskaidekaphobia
Triskaidekaphobia.desc: Your spells cost 0 mana. The 13th spell you cast on an adventure kills you and destroys your body.

Autism.name: Autism
Autism.desc: Spells you were born with cost -2 mana. Other spells cost +1 mana.

Tourettes.name: Tourette's Syndrome
Tourettes.desc: At the start of your turn, you have a 33% chance to cast one of your spells at a random target for free.

Albinism.name: Albinism
Albinism.desc:
Fire damage you take inflicts +3 Burn.
Your basic attack has a 25% chance to inflict Fear.

SleepParalysis.name: Sleep Paralysis
SleepParalysis.desc:
When you fall asleep, a Sleep Paralysis Demon with Madness spawns! You can't wake up until it's killed.
Learn the spell Rest (if you have a free spell slot).

Diabetes.name: Diabetes
Diabetes.desc: When you end your turn, if you haven't eaten food, gain All Stats Down and Confusion 1. Each time you eat food, cleanse all your debuffs and gain +1 INT.

Bipolar.name: Bipolar Disorder
Bipolar.desc:
Start each battle with either
 +5 INT, +5 CHA, and +5 SPD
or 
All Stats Down 2.

Soulless.name: Soulless
Soulless.desc: You are immune to buffs and debuffs. When you die, you don't leave a corpse.

Premonitions.name: The Shining
Premonitions.desc:
Your attacks can't miss.
+15% dodge chance and +15% chance to gain Fear at the start of each turn.

PillPopper.name: Addict
PillPopper.desc:
Start each battle with All Stats Down 2.
Gain All Stats Up 3 whenever you eat a pill.
You have a 50% chance to find a pill at the end of each battle.

Brave.name: Brave
Brave.desc:
Take your turn earlier.
Immune to Fear and Madness.
Attacks against you never miss.

Scatological.name: Scatological
Scatological.desc:
Heal 5 HP when you damage poop.
At the start of your turn, if you're near poop, you automatically move toward it and eat it.

Cannibal.name: Necrophage
Cannibal.desc: At the start of your turn, if there's a dead body near you, move towards it and eat it to gain All Stats Up and heal 4 HP.

CrohnsDisease.name: Crohn's Disease
CrohnsDisease.desc: At the end of your turn, you have a 20% chance to poop all over the place!

Pica.name: Pica
Pica.desc: When you collect a coin or scrap pickup, heal instead of gaining the pickup's normal effect.

FelineAids.name: Feline Aids
FelineAids.desc:
Your basic attack inflicts Poison 3 and Weakness 1.
Inflict Poison 3 and Weakness 1 on units that contact you.
Gain -1 CON and -1 SPD at the end of each battle permanently.

Dyslexia.name: Dyslexia
Dyslexia.desc: Swap 3's and 5's in the mana costs and damage values of your spells while in a battle. 6's and 9's are also swapped.

Covid.name: Covid
Covid.desc:
Start each battle with All Stats Down, Poison 1, and Weakness 1.
Your basic attack inflicts Poison 1 and Weakness 1.
15% chance of recovering at the end of each round. Contagious.

Flu.name: The Flu
Flu.desc:
Start each battle with Slow 5 and Weakness 5.
Your basic attack inflicts Slow 1 and Weakness 1.
20% chance of recovering at the end of each round. Contagious.

BirdFlu.name: Bird Flu
BirdFlu.desc:
Start each battle in Mockingbird Form.
You have a 20% chance to recover at the end of each battle.
Contagious.

Nudist.name: Nudist
Nudist.desc:
+50% dodge chance.
You can't wear armor.

Elephantiasis.name: Elephantiasis
Elephantiasis.desc: At the end of each battle, gain -1 SPD and +2 starting Shield permanently. After 8 battles, gain Trample.

Sociopathy.name: Sociopathy
Sociopathy.desc: You have Madness on your first turn.

SkillShare_Disorder.name: Munchausen by Proxy
SkillShare_Disorder.desc: If you have a 2nd disorder, all other cats in your party gain it at the start of each battle.

Schizophrenia.name: Schizophrenia
Schizophrenia.desc: At the end of your turn, spawn a hallucination. It has Madness, attacks any unit except you, and fades after its turn.

Lycanthropy.name: Lycanthropy
Lycanthropy.desc: 33% chance to enter Wolf Form at the start of your turn.

WobblyCat.name: Wobbly Cat Syndrome
WobblyCat.desc: 25% chance to block attacks and get knocked back 10 tiles instead.

Singleton.name: Singleton
Singleton.desc:
Your max HP and mana are reduced to 1.
Damage you take is reduced to 1.
Your spells cost 1 mana.

Insomnia.name: Insomnia
Insomnia.desc:
You can't fall asleep.
You can move an extra time each turn. Exhaustion sets in on round 3.

Phony.name: Phony
Phony.desc:
Start each battle with full mana.
You can't regenerate mana.

AcidReflux.name: Acid Reflux
AcidReflux.desc: Your basic attack becomes a lobbed shot with splash damage but deals 2 damage to you.

SpontaneousCombustion.name: Spontaneous Combustion
SpontaneousCombustion.desc: When you take damage from an ability, you have a 15% chance to inflict Burn 5 on yourself and adjacent units.

TheHunger.name: The Hunger
TheHunger.desc:
Your basic attack has lifesteal.
If you don't deal damage to a unit on your turn, gain Madness 1.

Paralyzed.name: Paraplegic
Paralyzed.desc:
The range of all your movement, dash, and jump abilities are capped at 1 unless they teleport.
Enemies won't prioritize attacking you.

GlassBones.name: Osteogenesis Imperfecta
GlassBones.desc:
+2 Bruise, +2 Bleed Thorns, and +2 Thorns.
When you're downed, you get injured an extra time.

BrainDead.name: Brain Dead
BrainDead.desc: Gain twice as many stats when you level up. +1 Reroll when leveling up.

TamperedGenes.name: Tainted Genes
TamperedGenes.desc: At the end of each battle gain a random mutation. When you're downed, your corpse is destroyed.

SensoryOverloadFace.name: Sensory Overload
SensoryOverloadFace.desc: All but your face slot is locked. Your face item's effects are tripled!

SensoryOverloadTrinket.name: Sensory Overload
SensoryOverloadTrinket.desc: All but your trinket slot is locked. Your trinket's effects are tripled!

SensoryOverloadHead.name: Sensory Overload
SensoryOverloadHead.desc: All but your head slot is locked. Your head item's effects are tripled!

SensoryOverloadNeck.name: Sensory Overload
SensoryOverloadNeck.desc: All but your neck slot is locked. Your neck item's effects are tripled!

SensoryOverloadWeapon.name: Sensory Overload
SensoryOverloadWeapon.desc: All but your weapon slot is locked. Your weapon's effects are tripled!

EternalYouth.name: Eternal Youth
EternalYouth.desc:
You are a kitten... forever!
+1 COMFORT, +1 STIMULATION, +1 APPEAL

DejaVu.name: Deja Vu
DejaVu.desc:
10% chance to cancel actions.
Deja Vu will go away when this cat returns to the house.

DarkOne.name: Dark One
DarkOne.desc: At end of your turn, deal 1 damage to all units and heal for the damage dealt. Whenever you down an ally gain All Stats Up.

ADHD.name: ADHD
ADHD.desc: You have 5 seconds to make decisions, or else this cat acts on its own.

FlamingFists.name: Flaming Fists
FlamingFists.desc: Your basic attacks inflict Burn 1. Start with Burn 1.

IntestinalProlapse.name: Intestinal Prolapse
IntestinalProlapse.desc: You receive double damage from behind.

BlackFetin.name: Black Fetin
BlackFetin.desc:
You have a 10% to be AI controlled each turn.
When an ally cat is downed, restore all your mana.

OrangeFetin.name: Orange Fetin
OrangeFetin.desc:
You have a 10% to be AI controlled each turn.
When you kill an enemy, gain 3 mana and heal 2 hp.

PurpleFetin.name: Purple Fetin
PurpleFetin.desc:
You have a 10% to be AI controlled each turn.
You can reroll your level up options 3 times.
